description_en: Two stone pillars are located to the north-western side of Rara lake. The pillars are located next to the path running along the shore of the lake.The two objects probably contained inscriptions but only the upper decorative motifs are extant. These motifs consist in representations of the sun and the moon, referring to the memory of the persons for whom the pillars were erected, and that will last "as long as the sun and the moon exist" (Andolfatto 2019). Pillar 002 is broken, only the upper part remains.Stone pillars were erected throughout the Karnali Basin from the 13th to the 17th century. They are installed to honor the memory of deceased persons, mostly warriors. In this case the pillars are datable to the 14th-15th century.The pillars are mentioned inSharma 2012: 195-197 andAndolfatto 2019.
description_ne: यी खम्बाहरू रारा ताल किनारको बाटो नजिकै छन् । यी दुई खम्बाहरू अभिलेखहरू कुँदिएको हुनुपर्दछ तर अहिले खम्बाहरूको माथिल्लोपट्टिको भागमा कुँदिएका सूर्य र चन्द्रका आकृतिमात्रै बाँकि छन् । दोस्रो खम्बा (Pillar 002) भाँचिएको छ र यसको माथिल्लो भागमात्रै अहिले देख्न सकिन्छ । यस्ता ढुङ्गाका खम्बाहरू ईशाको तेह्रौँ शताब्दीदेखि सत्रौँ शताब्दीसम्ममा कर्णालीभरनै गाडिएका थिए । मृत आफन्त वा मानिसको स्मृतिस्वरूप (विशेषतः योद्धाहरूको सम्झनामा) यी खम्बाहरू गाडिएका हुनुपर्दछ । यि उल्लिखित दुई खम्बाहरू ईशाको चौधौँ अथवा पन्ध्रौँ शताब्दीमा गाडिएका हुन सक्ने अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ ।
